item.title: NRMC honors Marie Woodel as newest Guardian Angel
item.description: Natchitoches Regional Medical Center recognized Marie Woodel, Medical Lab Scientist, as its latest Guardian Angel for exceptional service and dedication. Woodel was nominated by a colleague who praised her professionalism, responsiveness, and commitment during a demanding weekend shift. item.title: Remembering Tina Lynn Rachal
item.description: Tina Lynn Rachal was born in Natchitoches, LA on September 15, 1967 to R. G. and Krystyna Horton. She was a 1985 Natchitoches Central graduate. She also graduated from Natchitoches Technical College in medical transcription. She had many jobs in the medical field. item.title: NPL children’s department temporarily relocates services during facility improvements
item.description: The Natchitoches Parish Library (NPL) is investing in long-term facility improvements with a multi-phase flooring renewal project beginning this week. Starting Friday, Feb. 13, the Main Branch’s Children’s Department on the first floor will be temporarily closed through Friday, Feb. 27, with normal operations resuming Saturday, Feb. 28. item.title: Construction to begin February 16 on St. Maurice Lane
item.description: The City of Natchitoches announces that construction will begin during the week of Feb. 16 on the segment of St. Maurice Lane from Williams Avenue to East Fifth Street. This work will involve the construction of a new cement-treated base course, along with isolated asphalt pavement patching, followed by placement of new asphaltic concrete surfacing. … Continue reading Construction to begin February 16 on St. Maurice Lane

item.title: Patsy Ward Hoover qualifies for re-election as Mayor of the Village of Natchez
item.description: Patsy Johnson Ward Hoover officially qualified Wednesday, Feb. 11, for the upcoming election for Mayor of the Village of Natchez.
